ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Dominantly low-intensity (black/dark-grey) with localized high-intensity (white/pink) pixel clusters at the distal tips and sparse white stippling on the right lobe.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous dark-grey field across the fluke surface; a distinct high-contrast pinkish-white contiguous blob at the extreme left distal tip; sparse white point-source pixels scattered across the right lobe medial-distal quadrant.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped notch with an approximate 50-degree divergence between inner lobe boundaries.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular jagged topography; prominent deep-v serration at the distal third of the left lobe trailing edge; fine-grained, high-frequency peaks and valleys across the right lobe boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve following the leading edge, terminating in sharply pointed distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Sparse distribution of small, roughly circular white pixel clusters localized on the medial-to-distal region of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of faint, light-grey linear pixel disruptions oriented diagonally on the proximal region of the left lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Morphological irregularity at the left distal tip characterized by an accumulation of pink and white pixels and a ragged terminal edge.
other_distinctive_markers: A specific deep angular indentation on the upper trailing edge of the left lobe, approximately 70% distance from the median notch.
